Quiet low-contrast surface detail keeps room graphics readable. Neutral natural material colors, no teal underwater tint, no lighting vignette, no spotlight, no border, no transparency. Quiet continuous microtexture, no deep ridges, no cracks across large plates, no blue color, no obvious parallel graphic stripes.
